recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future regression check for profile XML ordering should be handled in the relevant FHIR Java/tooling repository or maintenance stream rather than by editing normative spec source.
issue_request: FHIR-5181 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment asking that programmatic profile XML generation order extension elements first and then other elements in core-resource order, shifting that ordering burden from implementers to the Java Reference Implementation/build tool.
initial_application: Jira records the accepted resolution as a build-tool enhancement to the reference implementation, and Grahame's 2015 comment says it was fixed in the RI and build tool. No current Git commit in this checkout explicitly mentions FHIR-5181.
additional_context: Current FHIR core source does not contain Java Reference Implementation source. The active Implementation Support page points reference implementations and profile tooling to external Confluence lists, and community searches found no directly relevant or conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The issue was already applied historically to tooling, and the remaining concern belongs outside the current FHIR core source/build scope.
